title: Overloading
question: What does FRSC Act 2007 section 26 say about overloading?
shortAnswer: FRSC Act 2007 s.26 — Offence: exceeding load limit; penalty: fine based on excess weight.

**Section 26 of the Federal Road Safety Commission (Establishment) Act, 2007** provides:

Offence: exceeding load limit; penalty: fine based on excess weight

This Act established the FRSC with responsibility for road safety management, traffic regulation, driver licensing, vehicle inspection, and accident prevention on federal highways.
